He delivered a 4,300% return on Supreme Industries.

He captured a massive 2800% return on HBL Power.

He made a 600% return on PG Electroplast.

He is none other than Abhishek Basumallick.

In my recent podcast, he revealed game-changing insights on stock selection and wealth creation:

→ Buy when prices go up, not down. A falling stock usually means you’re either buying a weak business or entering at the wrong time.

→ Technicals and price momentum drive short-term performance, but over the long term, fundamentals and earnings drive the stock price.

→ Role Luck & Alternate History. Every market outcome is just one of many possible paths that could have played out.

→ Why some stocks don't perform despite solid earnings growth: a stock may stagnate due to ongoing concerns from past promoter-related issues.
